title: Skin workshop close-ups, animated
desc: Pass 593's textures, now as an animated close tour per texture (wall, dome, particles, then the suit). J: "these i need to see animated on the site and closer up for each thing".

takes.name: W1 neon weave
takes.facts: close tour: wall 0-2 s, dome 2-4 s, particles 4-6 s, suit 6-8 s; green pick: the texture on the A1 Plates suit, a 3x2 block wall, a dome (r 1.5) and a ~420-pixel particle sphere; animated as the game strip
